description: Three-tier pricing section (Basic, Pro, Business) with a monthly/yearly frequency toggle above the cards. Prices animate between values using NumberFlow when the frequency changes, and a discount-percentage badge appears automatically on yearly billing. The middle 'Pro' plan is visually highlighted (scaled up, shaded header/footer, 'Popular' badge). Each card lists checkmarked features and ends with a CTA button, outlined for standard plans and filled for the highlighted plan.
example_prompts: Pricing section with three tiers and a monthly/yearly toggle
SaaS pricing cards with an animated price change and a highlighted popular plan
Pricing table with discount badge when switching to yearly billing
